name: Bramael Sableis
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: The Baopuzi contains the earliest known description of smallpox symptoms and practical chemistry alongside the immortality material.
text: Bramael sableis of the open ledger, keeps the book for the 9th tranche, doors 77 to 85. Keeps the replay, event by event. Reads Ge Hong.
